# Agency Eagle

> Agency Eagle builds and hosts fast, secure, plain-HTML websites for small businesses. No WordPress, no plugins. Based in Jefferson City, Tennessee, in business since 2002. Phone (865) 300-5397, sales@agencyeagle.com.

## Plans
- Hosting and portal, $99/month: hosting, backups, client portal, AI Brain for organic SEO, social ad tools, hashtag and hook post creation, site management and monitoring.
- Growth, $200/month: everything in Hosting and portal plus funnel management and tracking, Google Analytics, Meta Pixel and Google tag setup, and full AI access to the site through Agency Eagle's platform tools.
- Done-for-you website build, $5,000 one time. 30-day money-back guarantee on every website setup.
